level_formula_check: Five members offset 1 -> L83, Crabominable offset 2 -> L84. Confirmed.

attempts.narrative: T1 both leads Protected (blocked Fake Out and Heat Wave). T2 Bronzong chose Trick Room and Gourgeist Poltergeist, but Chi-Yu's Heat Wave OHKOed both first: the room never went up. T3 Heat Wave OHKO Heracross (Toxic Orb never activated); Florges Protected. T4 Heat Wave + Flare Blitz KO Copperajah; Florges Calm Mind. T5 Crabominable Mega Evolved, Florges Protected again, Mega Drain Punch OHKO Incineroar (329). T6 Crabominable Protected both attacks; +1 Moonblast KO Chi-Yu. T7 Flutter Mane Moonblast KO Mega Crabominable, Surging Strikes through Florges.

strategy_checks.check: Bronzong sets Trick Room when it helps (Mental Herb vs Taunt)
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Protect under Fake Out threat, T2 native choice Trick Room; died to Heat Wave before moving. Mental Herb not exercised (no Taunt used).

strategy_checks.check: Gourgeist attacks or burns the physical threat
Guts Heracross Toxic Orb -> Facade/Close Combat
strategy_checks.evidence: OHKOed by 4x Heat Wave on its first turn before the Orb activated.
T4 native choice High Horsepower into Chi-Yu; KOed before moving.

strategy_checks.check: Florges Calm Mind / Wish endgame with Protect
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Protect, T4 Calm Mind, T5 Protect, T6 +1 Moonblast KO Chi-Yu. Wish never needed. Flower Veil not exercised.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Crabominable Iron Fist Ice Hammer / Drain Punch
strategy_checks.evidence: Mega Evolved T5 on its first action turn; Drain Punch OHKO Incineroar (329/332); T6 Protect blocked Moonblast + Heat Wave.

strategy_checks.check: Zero Speed IVs make the crew genuinely slow
strategy_checks.evidence: Every opposing member moved after both my actives all fight; without the room the team was as slow as the crack line promises.

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked Fake Out; real (but delayed the room by a turn it never got)
blocked Heat Wave + Flare Blitz (lethal in sum); real
blocked Heat Wave + Flare Blitz again while Mega Crabominable KOed Incineroar; real
blocked Moonblast + Heat Wave (lethal in sum); real

level_change_rationale: Won on attempt 1 with two faints after five real Protects and a Mega that OHKOed Incineroar: a real fight -> keep.
could_this_be_cooler: The Speed-IV fix reads: this is a real Trick Room crew now, and Florges/Crabominable Protect timing was the best AI play in the block. The weak spot is that the room itself never appeared against the obvious Fire lead (Bronzong + Gourgeist both 2x to Fire, and Bronzong Protected turn 1 instead of setting under Mental Herb). Leading Bronzong beside Florges (Fire-neutral, can Protect the setter's turn with Wish pressure) would make the room happen more often; not changed in this pass.
